page.title: History
page.description: A record of when Streaming Tree observed a stream session run and which destinations participated. Never chat messages, chatter names, or donation content.

list.backendUnavailable: The backend could not be reached.

settings.heading: History settings
settings.clearConfirmMessage: This permanently deletes every recorded session and destination-participation record. This cannot be undone.
